final:
type Bad = { n: int }

check(x: int) -> int fail Bad =
  ex check(2) == 2
  ex check(4) == 4
  if x % 2 == 1
    fail Bad(n: x)
  x

-- Runs check on every element in parallel. The result is the failure
-- from the lowest-index odd element, regardless of which thread finishes first.
all_even(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] fail Bad =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex all_even([2, 4]) == [2, 4]
  let ys = par for x in xs
    check(x)?
  ys

test_all_even() =
  assert all_even([2, 4, 6]) == [2, 4, 6]
